description.p: Gallery organizes the photos in your Pictures folder, your own folders and on cameras, SD cards and USB drives: browse them by month, folder and device, search, mark favorites and make your own albums.
Import from cameras and cards, play slideshows, and rotate, resize and export, copy, move or share many photos at once. Photos open in Photo for viewing and editing.
Developed by the DebION Dev-Team for the Selviana Desktop Environment.
